openfour.mjs is the unmodified read-only Binance Agentic Wallet skill helper.

Runs in an isolated short-lived Node process for each quote to avoid shared RPC/block state.
No credentials are passed. This helper never signs or broadcasts transactions.
It is a server runtime dependency, not part of the public bang-connect skill ZIP.
